description: Prices protection for a payment to a counterparty you do not trust yet, without committing to anything. The fee is 1% of the amount, minimum $0.10, maximum $25.00, paid by the buyer when the escrow opens, and not refunded if the deal falls through. Needs no account. Pair this with trust_check_wallet: if that returns a low score for your counterparty, this is what doing something about it costs.

amount_usd.description: What you intend to pay the counterparty, in USD.

name: escrow_get_quote
